Be sure to pack this when venturing out to explore Death Mountain.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Fireproof Elixir}}
Grants a fireproof effect, which prevents your body from catching fire. Be sure to pack this when venturing out to explore caves in Death Mountain.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fireproof Elixirs will grant [[Link]] [[Flame Guard]] when drunk, preventing him from catching fire in a [[Scorching Climate]]. They're useful when traversing [[Death Mountain]]. Two merchants sell Fireproof Elixirs. [[Gaile]], a worker at [[Foothill Stable]], has them available for travelers heading to [[Goron City]].{{Cite|If you're headed to Goron City, I'll sell you some of my {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof elixirs}}.|Gaile|BotW}} She suggests taking at least three, as this is what regular Goron City travelers do.{{Cite|Even Goron City regulars usually take {{Color BotW|Red|at least three}} elixirs with them.|Gaile|BotW}} One elixir costs 60 [[Rupee]]s, two cost 110 Rupees, and three cost 150 Rupees.{{Cite|It's {{Color BotW|Red|60 rupees}} for one, {{Color BotW|Red|110 rupees}} for two, and {{Color BotW|Red|150 rupees}} for three. Buying in bulk pays off here!|Gaile|BotW}} If Link refuses to buy, Gaile advises him to give up on Goron City.{{Cite|I see. I won't waste my breath arguing about it. Just trust me when I say you should give up on going to Goron City.|Gaile|BotW}} Once Link has at least three, she'll tell him he's ready to head to Goron City.{{Cite|If you have that many, you should be able to make it to Goron City no problem.|Gaile|BotW}} In Goron City, Link can speak to [[Offrak]], who will ask if he needs a Fireproof Elixir.{{Cite|Need a {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof elixir}}? You do, yeah?|Offrak|BotW}} If Link admits that he does, Offrak will offer to sell him one for 60 Rupees.{{Cite|[I probably do.] Here's what I'll do, fella. Just for you, I'll sell ya that {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof elixir}} at a special price of only {{Color BotW|Red|60 rupees}}!|Offrak|BotW}} Link can refuse, causing Offrak to become angry and say he shouldn't come crying to him when he's on fire.{{Cite|Well, don't come cryin' to me when you're on fire, fella!|Offrak|BotW}} Offrak will attempt to coerce Link into buying more, saying a [[Hylian]] will need it.{{Cite|A {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian}} like you will need more than that! A {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof elixir}} will cost ya {{Color BotW|Red|60 rupees}}.|Offrak|BotW}} Once Link stops buying, Offrak comments under his breath that Link could easily make his own.{{Cite|{{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|All you need to do is cook one}} {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof lizard with monster parts}}{{Color BotW|Gray|, fella...}}}}|Offrak|BotW}} Fireproof Elixirs can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]: * [[Smotherwing Butterfly]] * [[Fireproof Lizard]] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
